## What changes for users?

## Verification

- [ ] Focused regression test fails before the fix and passes after it
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e`
- [ ] Docs updated alongside changed behavior
- [ ] No secrets, real profile dumps, or paid requests in tests

## Risk and rollout

Call out payment, data, auth, schema, or deployment changes. State what was
not tested. UI changes include desktop/mobile screenshots with synthetic data.
